Both compounds are C10 skeletons, but Caulibugulone E carries three nitrogens and an oxygen (C10H9N3O, 187.20 Da) while Dipentylamine is a simple secondary amine (C10H23N, 157.30 Da), so Caulibugulone E is the heavier by ~29.9 Da.
